comment: Single packaged transport profile vocabulary shared by Access, Host and Core. All byte limits are encoded bytes. packetBytes is the largest complete encoded MQTT PUBLISH accepted; envelopeBytes is the largest complete encoded message carried inline or by reference. brokerPacketLimitBytes is the deployment's checked broker PUBLISH ceiling: no profile may exceed it. A profile is validated before readiness; invalid relations fail startup or connection setup. Application protocol version stays 1 and the relay epoch stays 3.
